latestPosts.caption:
Spring Cleaning Ep 3/20 🌸✨ bathroom deep clean ✔️ .. so overdue! Bathrooms are a weekly task here but life has happened the past few weeks so it needed a good scrub & WOW it came up sooo clean 😍🫧 definitely motivation to keep on top of it 🙌🏽 

if you would like the list of the products I use, comment “LIST” and I’ll send it through to you 🥰

SPRING CLEANING 🌼 episode 1 🤭 we put a list together of 20 spaces around the house that need a deep clean, declutter or just a reset! I’ve always shared us cleaning together because team work makes the dream work!! 👩🏽‍🤝‍👨🏻✨We’re starting off with a BIG task… the windows 🥲😂 They get so dirty from the kids’ handprints and Bonnie’s little nose prints, so it was definitely time! One down, 19 to go 🙌🏽✨
It’s spring 🥰🌸 which means it’s time to deep clean everything 🤣 the lawns was definitely in need of a clean & tidy 🙌🏽 so glad it’s done but don’t get use to it Jeremy 😵‍💫😂

Amazon purchases I have zero regrets about 🤭✨I’ve had most of them for years & would 100% buy them again if needed! Comment “YES” if you’d like the links 💕

@amazonaustralia

It’s that time againnnnn… I do this every few months cleaning & decluttering the kids’ rooms ✨ I dread this because it takes so long going through everything 😂 but it’s always worth it! It makes it so much easier for the kids to keep their rooms clean & maintain them afterwards 🙌🏽 also got a new rug from @missamaraloves this is the Juliana pink & cream washable rug! Love how it brightens up the space…Cora’s room done ✔️ tomorrow will be Islas room 🙌🏽
